screening_population: 3103 observational-nursery newborns; 197 NICU admissions were outside nursery cohort; 2961 screened
screening_timing_raw: Saudi MOH protocol 12-24 h; sometimes <12 h for early discharge
screening_algorithm_raw: pre/postductal Saudi MOH protocol; up to 3 screens 1 h apart; persistent failure -> cardiologist/echo

diagnosis_categories_raw: study-defined critical cardiac defects; severe pulmonary hypertension; PFO; stable VSD; large symptomatic PDA

lesion_mapping_status: HLHS2 + standalone TGA1 are definite harmonized CCHD. Pulmonary stenosis is conditional and no <=28-day surgery/catheterization/death is documented, so it remains in denominator. Pulmonary atresia lacks septal anatomy: if PA/IVS it is harmonized CCHD; otherwise it remains denominator. AV canal and truncus are not automatic harmonized CCHD.
management_actionability_evidence: The paper states prostaglandin was started and urgent transfer arranged for ductus-dependent patients, but does not identify which individual cardiac lesions received that management; this aggregate statement is not used to assign Strict events to denominator participants. Severe PH13, large symptomatic PDA44, AV canal1, truncus1, PS1 and PA1 if denominator are CAN-U. PFO45 + stable VSD5 are NON_CAN under locked incidental/stable-lesion rules.
poolability_reason: terminal diagnosis ascertainment is complete but harmonized denominator cannot be point-identified because PA/IVS versus PA with non-intact/unspecified septum is unresolved; no primary meta-analysis weight assigned
source_full_text_provenance: Primary full text: Almawazini AM et al. Saudi Med J. 2017;38(10):1019-1024. PMID 28917066; PMCID PMC5694635; DOI 10.15537/smj.2017.10.20295.
extraction_notes: If PA qualifies as PA/IVS: denominator110, CAN-U60, NON_CAN50. If PA remains harmonized-negative: denominator111, CAN-U61, NON_CAN50. Strict=0 throughout; Expanded proportion 54.5%-55.0%. Al-Baha altitude flag is external geographic context, not source-reported altitude.
